room.idempotency_key: UUID retained by the caller for the exact reviewed action, including uncertain retries
room.scope: Server-derived session key and actor slug
room.payload_binding: Durable partner_room_turn row compares room, sponsor, seat, kind, body and origin attribution before replay
room.replay: Original seq, at and message identity; no duplicate append; no time bucket
room.key_reuse: HTTP 409 when the same scoped key names different material

mcp_session.binding: S2 callers retain /auth/session.csrf_token with the operation and send x-carr-csrf on every attempt
mcp_session.enforcement: If present, the header must match the verified cookie session's synchronizer token; mismatch returns HTTP 403 csrf_mismatch before MCP dispatch
mcp_session.legacy: Requests without this header retain their existing behavior; S2 writes must always supply it

concurrency: Version locked and compared inside the writer transaction; mismatch is version_conflict before replacement; no silent rebase
receipt_recovery: Same-key serialization and original envelope receipt lookup precede the expected-version check
consumer_order: Coordinate consumer and producer updates: the old producer rejects new base_version fields; the new producer safely refuses old consumers missing required versions. S2 session binding requires both the operation-bound consumer header and this producer's header enforcement. No deployment order alone makes an old pair satisfy this contract.
